import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots to show comprehensive insights
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Survival rate by passenger class and sex
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().reset_index()
survival_pivot = survival_by_class_sex.pivot(index='class', columns='sex', values='survived')
survival_pivot = survival_pivot.reindex(['First', 'Second', 'Third'])
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[0, 0], color=['#FF69B4', '#4169E1'], alpha=0.8)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Gender', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 0].set_xticklabels(axes[0, 0].get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Sex', labels=['Female', 'Male'])
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
axes[0, 0].set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
axes[0, 1].hist([df[df['survived']==1]['age'].dropna(), 
                 df[df['survived']==0]['age'].dropna()], 
                bins=20, label=['Survived', 'Died'], color=['#2ECC71', '#E74C3C'], alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 1].legend()
axes[0, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Survival count by embarkation port
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_survival = embark_survival.reindex(['Southampton', 'Cherbourg', 'Queenstown'])
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=axes[1, 0], 
                     color=['#E74C3C', '#2ECC71'], alpha=0.8)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Passenger Count by Embarkation Port and Survival', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(axes[1, 0].get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Survived', labels=['Died', 'Survived'])
axes[1, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Fare vs Age scatter plot colored by survival
survived_df = df[df['survived'] == 1]
died_df = df[df['survived'] == 0]
axes[1, 1].scatter(died_df['age'], died_df['fare'], alpha=0.5, c='#E74C3C', 
                   label='Died', s=30, edgecolors='none')
axes[1, 1].scatter(survived_df['age'], survived_df['fare'], alpha=0.5, c='#2ECC71', 
                   label='Survived', s=30, edgecolors='none')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Fare vs Age by Survival Status', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 1].legend()
axes[1, 1].grid(alpha=0.3)
axes[1, 1].set_ylim(0, 300)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
